name: savior
description: A local Claude Code mod that keeps a provider's tone policy out of your private draft.

scripts.watch:test: cargo test --locked -p savior-review --features watch live:: && node --test tests/watch.spec.mjs
scripts.watch:profile: cargo build --locked --profile profiling -p savior-cli && node scripts/profile-watch.mjs
scripts.bench:build: npm run build && cargo build --locked --release -p savior --example inference
scripts.bench:build:debug: npm run build:debug && cargo build --locked -p savior-cli && cargo build --locked -p savior --example inference
scripts.bench:test: node --test tests/battle.spec.mjs tests/triage.spec.mjs tests/host-evidence.spec.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/release -p test_installed_terminal.py
scripts.build: napi build --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --package savior-node --platform --output-dir native --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts --release -- --locked && cargo build --locked --release -p savior-cli -p savior-review --features savior-review/judge,savior-review/inspector
scripts.inspect:test: cargo clippy --locked -p savior-review --features judge,inspector --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked -p savior-review --features judge,inspector --test traces && node --test tests/bootstrap.spec.mjs
scripts.build:debug: napi build --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --package savior-node --platform --output-dir native --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts -- --locked
scripts.compatibility:test: node --test tests/compatibility-window.spec.mjs tests/host-evidence.spec.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/release -p test_compatibility_run.py
scripts.check: npm run types:fetch && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.plugin.json
scripts.build:test-runners: cargo build --locked --release -p savior --example inference && cargo build --locked --release -p savior-cli --example invalid_report
scripts.test: npm run build:test-runners && cargo test --locked --workspace && node --test tests/*.spec.mjs
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict .claude-plugin/plugin.json
scripts.profile:memory: cargo build --locked --profile profiling -p savior-cli && node --heap-prof scripts/profile.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run branding:verify && npm run models:verify && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm run check && npm test && npm run validate && npm run test:plugin
scripts.policy:compare:profiling: cargo run --locked --profile profiling -p savior-review --features judge -- policy-compare
scripts.build:inference:accelerate: cargo build --locked --profile profiling -p savior --examples --features accelerate --target-dir target/accelerate
scripts.build:inference:metal: cargo build --locked --profile profiling -p savior --examples --features metal --target-dir target/metal
scripts.build:inference:ffi:accelerate: napi build --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --package savior-node --features savior/accelerate --profile profiling --target-dir target/accelerate --output-dir .cache/native-accelerate --platform --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts -- --locked
scripts.build:inference:coreml: cargo build --locked --profile profiling -p savior --examples --features coreml --target-dir target/coreml
scripts.build:inference:ffi:metal: napi build --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --package savior-node --features savior/metal --profile profiling --target-dir target/metal --output-dir .cache/native-metal --platform --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts -- --locked
scripts.build:inference:ffi:coreml: napi build --manifest-path crates/node/Cargo.toml --package savior-node --features savior/coreml --profile profiling --target-dir target/coreml --output-dir .cache/native-coreml --platform --js index.cjs --dts index.d.ts -- --locked
scripts.build:decisions: cargo build --locked --profile profiling -p savior-lab --bin decision && cargo build --locked --profile profiling -p savior --example inference
scripts.build:decisions:debug: cargo build --locked -p savior-lab --bin decision && cargo build --locked -p savior --example inference
scripts.build:decisions:release: cargo build --locked --release -p savior-lab --bin decision && cargo build --locked --release -p savior --example inference
scripts.test:decisions: cargo test --locked -p savior decision::tests && cargo test --locked -p savior-lab --bin decision && node --test tests/benchmark.spec.mjs tests/decision.spec.mjs
scripts.profile:decisions:memory: cargo build --locked --profile profiling -p savior --example inference_memory && node scripts/benchmark-inference.mjs --runner target/profiling/examples/inference_memory --detector crf --target-ms 500 --samples 1 --warmup 0 --fixtures-file tests/fixtures/decision-performance.json
